sql: WITH o AS ( SELECT o.id, o.kalshi_order_id, o.strategy, o.market_ticker, o.created_at, o.status, o.limit_price, o.quantity, o.cancel_reason FROM live_orders o WHERE o.strategy IN ('Cmmsell10','Dmmsell10','Emmsell10','Fmmsell10') AND o.kalshi_order_id IS NOT NULL AND o.created_at >= now() - interval '336 hours' ), t AS ( SELECT t.kalshi_order_id, min(t.captured_at) AS first_at, max(t.captured_at) AS last_at, count(*) AS ticks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.queue_position IS NULL) AS null_ticks, (array_agg(t.contracts_ahead ORDER BY t.captured_at))[1] AS first_ahead, min(t.contracts_ahead) AS min_ahead, max(t.contracts_ahead) AS max_ahead FROM live_order_queue_ticks t GROUP BY 1 ), j AS ( SELECT o.*, t.first_at, t.last_at, t.ticks, t.null_ticks, t.first_ahead, t.min_ahead, t.max_ahead, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.last_at - o.created_at))/60.0 AS last_seen_min, CASE WHEN t.first_ahead IS NULL THEN 'no_tel' WHEN t.first_ahead=0 THEN 'b0' WHEN t.first_ahead<=10 THEN 'b1_10' WHEN t.first_ahead<=100 THEN 'b11_100' WHEN t.first_ahead<=1000 THEN 'b101_1k' WHEN t.first_ahead<=5000 THEN 'b1k_5k' ELSE 'b5k+' END AS bucket FROM o LEFT JOIN t ON t.kalshi_order_id = o.kalshi_order_id ) SELECT bucket, status, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='filled' AND last_seen_min <= 30) AS f30, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='filled' AND last_seen_min <= 60) AS f60, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='filled' AND last_seen_min <= 120) AS f120, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='filled' AND last_seen_min <= 240) AS f240, round(avg(last_seen_min)::numeric,1) AS avg_last_seen_min, round(percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY last_seen_min)::numeric,1) AS p50_last_seen_min, round(avg(ticks)::numeric,1) AS avg_ticks, sum(null_ticks) AS null_ticks, round(avg(limit_price)::numeric,1) AS avg_px, sum(quantity) AS qty FROM j GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
